theme: One midday call, open water, and a stack of trip bookings to close from shore.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar barely touches today — just the NACD New England programming call at 1. The real pressure is the trip itself: the Croatia wind-down and the Florida landing both need bookings locked before you lose signal.

needsAttention.title: Lock Croatia's Saturday exit from shore
needsAttention.detail: The Komolac-to-Cavtat transfer, a bag hold before 3 PM check-in, and the ~5:15 AM Sunday checkout for your 7:30 flight all still need arranging (Todoist p1) — and charter signal is poor, so do it while you can.

needsAttention.title: Florida car and the Sept 20-21 gap nights
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV at TPA for Sept 20-Oct 5 and two nights' St Pete lodging before the kids' Tue pickup are both still open (Todoist p1) — you arrive jet-lagged on a Sunday, so don't land without them.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week was flagged to book this week (Todoist, overdue Sept 14) — holiday inventory there sells out early.

schedule.title: NACD New England Programming Committee
schedule.detail: Zoom · 7 PM your time in Croatia

flagged.title: Brunswick passed your resume along
flagged.detail: Lauren Nadig wrote this morning that she shared your CV with Brunswick recruitment and with Courtney in New York, and will follow up on who to connect with — no reply owed yet.

inbox.noise: The rest is ICGN conference promos, a LinkedIn job alert, a Figma update, and Navionics boating notifications.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first crisp apples, and a free-form galette lets them shine with minimal fuss.

tasks.title: Confirm the Nautilus return transfer to the airport

acts.line: A clear stretch on the water before anything is owed to the calendar.
One fixed point midday — the NACD New England programming call — then the day reopens.
Closing out Saturday's transfers and the Florida landing is the evening's real work, best done while you still have a signal.
